title: Steelers gave DK Metcalf $150 million, traded George Pickens. Now they're paying for both decisions

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers gave DK Metcalf $150 million, traded George Pickens. Now they're paying for both decisions
sources.description: The Steelers wanted a more dependable receiver. Instead, Metcalf has delivered disappointing production and familiar distractions.
